en.headline: Golden Week day one sees 1.08 million border crossings
en.dek: Immigration figures for Thursday show more than 590,000 arrivals, including about 277,000 mainland visitors.
body: Hong Kong recorded about 1.08 million passenger crossings on the first day of the National Day Golden Week, the Immigration Department's tally showed on Friday.
Arrivals totalled more than 590,000 and departures more than 490,000. Mainland visitors accounted for about 277,000 of the arrivals and more than 209,000 of the departures.

The busiest inbound points for mainland visitors were Lok Ma Chau Spur Line, with more than 115,000, Lo Wu with close to 110,000, and Shenzhen Bay with about 88,000. On the way out, Lo Wu handled nearly 113,000 mainland visitors.

An earlier count on Thursday night had put mainland arrivals at nearly 270,000 by 9pm. The full-day figure confirms that most of that traffic had already arrived by then. Immigration has previously said it expects about 7.44 million crossings, residents and visitors combined, from 1 to 7 October.

zh.headline: 黃金周首日進出境約108萬人次
zh.dek: 入境處周五公布周四全日數字，入境逾59萬人次，當中內地旅客約27萬7千。
body: 入境處周五公布的數字顯示，內地國慶黃金周首日，本港錄得約108萬人次進出境。
入境逾59萬人次，出境逾49萬人次。當中內地旅客入境約27萬7千人次，出境逾20萬9千人次。
內地旅客入境最多經落馬洲支線，逾11萬5千人次，其次為羅湖近11萬人次，深圳灣約8萬8千人次。出境方面，羅湖處理近11萬3千人次內地旅客。
周四晚上9時的中期數字曾顯示內地旅客入境接近27萬。全日數字顯示，大部分人流在該時段前已經抵港。入境處早前估計，10月1日至7日連居民及訪客在內約有744萬人次進出本港。
